title: Avuhz Slice 1 Timestamp Primitives v1
description: Provider-neutral UTC timestamp primitives for Slice 1 contracts. Server-recorded semantics are enforced by command processing and are not established by caller-supplied values.

utcTimestamp.title: UTC RFC 3339 Timestamp
utcTimestamp.description: An RFC 3339 date-time written in unambiguous UTC Z form, optionally with one to nine fractional-second digits.
